why_null: All four cases in the library were considered against the mbg-cut motif, and none clears the conservative threshold. B-01, casualty-inflation cascade, motif of moral shock carried by a fabricated count: this cluster contains no invented quantity and no moral shock, its figures are attributed on the record to the finance minister and to Kompas, Antara and Databoks reporting, and its gap is a step never stated rather than a count never observed. B-02, fabricated-provision cascade, motif of scope inflation over a text whose final version was not yet public: nothing here restates a provision or a document, and no narrow instrument is widened in the telling. B-03, moral-shock acceleration: no triggering image, no hours-long mobilization sequence, no part of that shape repeats. B-04, scope-inflation panic with manufactured urgency, was the closest candidate and is still refused. The B-04 shape is a rule written narrow and retold wide, where a restricted measure was applied to a whole consumption basket. The shape in this cluster is different in kind: a reduced ceiling and a cumulative drawdown covering months already closed each sit on the record separately, the step between them is never stated, and the envelope remaining for the rest of the year is never carried. That is an unstated denominator and an unstated step, not a scope widened in the telling. The two share fiscal subject matter and a ministry, which is topic and institution overlap, and the threshold excludes both. No historical case in the library repeats the structural motif, so this cluster ships without an Echo panel.
